import numpy as np
def derivative_lo(fn, acc):
    h = 1e-6
    a, s = 0.5, 0.3
    num = -(acc(a + h, 12.0, 0.2, 0.15, s) - acc(a - h, 12.0, 0.2, 0.15, s)) / (2.0 * h)
    return float(abs(fn(a, 12.0, 0.2, 0.15, s) - num) < 1e-5 * abs(num))
assert np.allclose(derivative_lo(width_curvature, width_acceleration), target)

import numpy as np
def power_drift(fn):
    g = _grid(256, 20.0)
    x = g[0]; dx = x[1]-x[0]
    u0 = (np.exp(-x**2/2.0)).astype(complex)
    p0 = float(np.sum(np.abs(u0)**2)*dx)
    u = fn(u0, 256, 20.0, np.full(200, 3.0), 0.01, 0.2, 0.15, 3.0, 'sigma')
    return float(abs((np.sum(np.abs(u)**2)*dx - p0)/p0) < 1e-10)
assert np.allclose(power_drift(propagate_field), target)
